messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Handlers spend hours on the phone each day instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
  quote: Every single day. We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
- problem: The team has to manually chase claim updates by phone, making it a burdensome daily task.
  quote: we’ll keep chasing them by phone — just wish it wasn’t part of our daily workflow.
- problem: The current process is annoying and consumes time that could be used for policyholders or other tasks.
  quote: Exactly — and it’s not just annoying, it’s eating into time we could spend on policyholders or tasks.
